# Source: The Departure of the Boats, Étretat

This GameCore theme is derived from a **specific, real, public-domain work**—not a generated palette.

## Work

- **Title:** The Departure of the Boats, Étretat
- **Artist / culture:** Claude Monet (French, 1840–1926)
- **Date:** 1885
- **Style:** Impressionism
- **Classification:** painting
- **Department:** Painting and Sculpture of Europe
- **AIC artwork ID:** 81540
- **Artwork page:** https://www.artic.edu/artworks/81540
- **Public-domain image:** https://www.artic.edu/iiif/2/6ca224d1-c3dc-a223-a127-0492301a2ebb/full/400,/0/default.jpg
- **Research category:** Ocean and Seascape

## Extracted source palette

`#88A8A8, #A89898, #484848, #B8C8C8, #686868, #887878, #687888, #888898`

The image was downsampled deterministically and quantized to a four-bit-per-channel histogram.
Colors were ranked by pixel population and de-duplicated by RGB distance. No random values are used.

## Semantic adaptation

- `background`: `#252525`
- `surface`: `#3E3E3E`
- `on_surface`: `#F8F8F6`
- `primary`: `#88A8A8`
- `on_primary`: `#0C0C0E`
- `secondary`: `#B8C8C8`
- `surface_variant`: `#3E3E3E`
- `on_surface_variant`: `#F8F8F6`
- `outline`: `#606060`
- `error`: `#88A8A8`
- `on_error`: `#0C0C0E`

- Font: `serif` (chosen from source style/classification)
- Corner radius: `20dp` (chosen from source object/design classification)
- Body contrast: background `14.42:1`, surface `10.06:1`
- Variant contrast: `10.06:1`
- Control contrast: `7.64:1`

Backgrounds retain a source hue but are toned toward neutral only when needed to ensure body text is
at least 7.0:1. The primary action remains an extracted source color and its ink is chosen
for at least 4.5:1.
